episodes.title: Gajar Ka Halwa!
episodes.topic: Winter carrot season - Abba brings 5 kg cheap gajar, nobody wants to grate them, Abba's 'humare zamane' boast makes it his job; low evening gas pressure slows the halwa; Daniyal 'khushboo ka gawah', Arsalan 'studied gajar ke fawaid' and gets the ladle; helpers get the first plates, Daniyal gets dishes duty

episodes.title: Dadi Ka Sweater!
episodes.topic: Cold wave - winter sweaters come out (naphthalene smell), Arsalan's last-year sweater too small because he grew (goes to Mehak), Abba gives him Dadi's hand-knitted 30-year-old sweater; embarrassed at first, next morning in gali cricket he is the only one not shivering
